Meir Orbach / CTech :

 Dante Security, which has developed a platform for monitoring the activity of AI agents within organizations, raised a $10M seed led by NFX   —  Dante Security is developing a platform that gives organizations visibility into the actions of autonomous AI agents and connects their activity to the employees responsible for them.
